bug_report:
[OpenMP] c-parser.cc: Improve location of c_parser_omp_variable_list for kind=0
tree list
                    = c_parser_omp_variable_list (parser, loc, OMP_CLAUSE_ERROR,
                                                  NULL_TREE);

where kind = 0 (== OMP_CLAUSE_ERROR) has no location data for decls, which leads to bad error diagnostic, in particular with declare variant's adjust_args,
cf. c_finish_omp_declare_variant, but also elsewhere.

This has been fixed for C++ with:r15-6512-gcf94ba812ca496OpenMP/C++: Store location in cp_parser_omp_var_list for kind=0https://gcc.gnu.org/pipermail/gcc-patches/2025-January/672469.htmlThe same fix should also be done for C!

We may consider to also add a testcase for this...
